text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Mom and Dad. I'm writing today's 
letter from Sapporo. The air here feels a 
lot like Morioka, so I've been able to 
relax."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"People in Sapporo knew about the 'Snow 
Angel,' but this time, I truly want to win 
their hearts through my racing..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I went into the Queen Stakes determined 
to win and build momentum!"
